synthesis:draft.headline: VIC1 negative-price event on 2026-07-28: -504.6525 $/MWh at 2026-07-28 21:20 AEST
summary: The price extreme observed in the window was -504.6525 $/MWh at 2026-07-28 21:20 AEST (interval end 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z) [cited price evidence ev0483].
No 5-minute intervals in the window exceeded the analysis threshold; the analysis threshold used was 300.0 $/MWh [ev0925][ev0926].

Operational demand in the half-hour containing the price extreme (half-hour ending 2026-07-28T11:30:00Z / 2026-07-28 21:30 AEST) was 7491.0 MW, and the window maximum operational demand observed was 8131.0 MW [ev0951][ev0973].

AEMO published notices for VIC in the event window that reference automated constraint sets affecting inter-regional transfer and a later non-credible contingency (see published_findings and citations) [c1][c2][c3].

Tool outputs show increases in output at several wind units and bidirectional battery behaviour in the window (examples: GPWFEST2 ev0978, GPWFEST1 ev0981, YENDONWF ev0984, MRNBESS1 ev0996; see observation_evidence_ids).

possible_explanations.statement: High output from variable renewable generation in the window may have contributed to surplus supply at times; wind-unit output increases are observed in the generation-change tool outputs (examples listed in supporting_evidence_ids).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve 5-minute metered generation for the named wind units and the 5-minute offer stack and rebids for the specific dispatch periods around 2026-07-28T11:15:00Z–2026-07-28T11:25:00Z to see whether high wind output coincided with low or negative-priced offers.

possible_explanations.statement: Battery behaviour (charging or discharging) might have contributed to low prices in some intervals; bidirectional units show charging/negative MW observations in the window.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Fetch 5-minute battery dispatch records and participant bids for the batteries around the negative intervals to determine whether batteries were charging at negative prices or dispatching in ways that affected marginal price.

possible_explanations.statement: AEMO-invoked constraint automation that references inter-regional transfer terms may have changed local dispatch outcomes; the retrieved market notice reports an automated constraint set invoked from 11:00 hrs [c1].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve the CA_SYDS_597A8B26 constraint equations and the 5-minute interconnector flow time series for the V-S-MNSP1 terms around 11:00–11:30 UTC to check whether constraint activation coincided with changes in interchange or binding constraints in the 11:15–11:25 UTC intervals.

possible_explanations.statement: Negative or very low-priced offers or rebids from one or more generators could have produced extreme single 5-minute negative RRPs; rebid or offer records are not present in the current evidence but could show negative-priced offers at the extreme interval.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain 5-minute offers and rebid records and the dispatch merit order for the 2026-07-28T11:20:00Z dispatch interval to see whether offers with negative prices were on the margin.
